hook: Three years on, still no non-WebKit iPhone browser.

beats.say: Mozilla says Firefox daily use on iOS has doubled since Europe's Digital Markets Act forced a browser choice screen.
But nearly three years after Apple allowed other engines in the EU, and almost a year in Japan, nobody has shipped one.
To use Gecko, Mozilla would have to ship a second Firefox app and ask users to move everything over by hand. It calls it a trap door.
